guardrails: No new data values are inserted into any historical forecast or target by this audit.
PKV labor includes employer charges and pensions. A local pension path must replace a disjoint pension component, never be added on top of the entire existing PKV personnel projection.
The saved payroll variable is not a pure wage bill; note4 classification changed. Do not score its growth or the pension subseries as separately comparable forecasts.
Pension operating expense, pension finance, cash payments and provision changes are distinct. Do not infer full pension expense or payments solely from the change in a balance-sheet provision.

A residual between a constant-quantity PKV projection and observed total personnel cost combines price, pension, composition, staffing and possible version effects. It is not an identified price or pension error.
